items.title: Sammy Penn Interview, 1960-04-21
items.q: Jewel used to use a fellow by the name of Tom Harris.

ctx.x: Yeah. So it seems anybody ever knew him, but I was Zeb. Yeah, well that's all I knew. That's all I knew. Now was anybody else in the band you can remember? Like did you have a bass fiddle or a banjo or a guitar?
Yeah, they had a bass fiddle in the band. Jewel used to use a fellow by the name of Tom Harris. Oh, Tom Harris. Yeah, he was a bass player. He was a good bass player too. Now you know him well.
Oh yeah, I think you mentioned his name. He was in the picture. Was that the band, was that the band? Was that the band? Was that the man in the band? Let me see, we got about five.
